E2-2020-T4-P1-S1.trunk: 时间状语从句 + 主句：Now that Generation Z are graduating..., the attention has been rising（既然Z世代正在毕业，关注度持续上升）
structure: 原因/时间状语从句(Now that)：members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring
└ 破折号插入：the most commonly accepted definition says
└ 宾语从句(that)：this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year
主句：the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks
E2-2020-T4-P1-S1.logic: Now that 给出关注增加的现实背景；两个破折号之间插入Z世代的出生年份定义，主句落到近期关注趋势。
notes: now that：既然、由于现在已经。
give or take a year：上下相差一年左右。

E2-2020-T4-P1-S5.trunk: 条件对比句：If 'entitled' is the adjective applied to millennials, the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious（如果千禧一代的标签是……，Z世代的关键词则是……）
structure: 条件从句(if)：entitled is the most common adjective applied to millennials
└ 同位解释：those born between 1981 and 1995
主句：the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious
E2-2020-T4-P1-S5.logic: if 在这里并非真实条件，而是建立代际标签对比；插入语承认对千禧一代评价可能不公。
notes: entitled：自认为理应获得特殊待遇的。

E2-2020-T4-P1-S16.trunk: 引语 + notes Tanya Michelsen + 定语从句（米克尔森指出……，并补充其调查背景）
structure: 直接引语：Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives
└ 同位语扩展：a UK-based brand manager
└ 定语从句(that)：that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth
└ 定语从句(that)：that might just as well apply to American youth
E2-2020-T4-P1-S16.logic: 核心是引语及其说话人；两个同位语和两个 that 从句交代机构性质、调查方式及结论的适用范围。
notes: might just as well apply to：很可能同样适用于。
UK-based：总部或业务基础在英国的。
